description: Detects additions to a Tier-0 admin group (Domain Admins). Privilege escalation via group membership is a common persistence/escalation step, and every change should map to an approved change request.

detection.logic_plain_english: Alert on every single event where a member is added to the Domain Admins group. Volume is expected to be near zero, so no threshold is applied.

false_positive_notes: Legitimate changes happen during approved admin onboarding and break-glass maintenance. The triage step is verifying the change ticket and the actor, not suppressing the rule - keep it at 1:1 alerting.
log_source: Directory audit logs (Entra ID audit / Windows Security 4728, 4756)
name: Member added to privileged admin group
